mapper.select: SELECT * FROM camera ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO camera (vehicle_id, driver_id, stream_url, sample_interval_seconds, enabled) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{driverId}, #{streamUrl}, #{sampleIntervalSeconds}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE camera SET vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}, driver_id = #{driverId}, stream_url = #{streamUrl}, sample_interval_seconds = #{sampleIntervalSeconds}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE camera SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
